description: Source code for the 'MigrationPreparerJsonRpc.cpp' file implementing JSON-RPC endpoints within the WPEFramework plugin, managing migration operations such as read, write, delete, component readiness, and reset.

classes.name: MigrationPreparer
classes.description: Class implementing JSON RPC endpoints for migration operations, including file management and component readiness.

methods.name: endpoint_write
methods.description: Handles write requests; validates parameters and invokes migration write operation.

methods.name: endpoint_read
methods.description: Handles read requests; validates parameters and retrieves data from migration.

methods.name: endpoint_delete
methods.description: Handles delete requests; validates parameters and deletes specified migration data.

methods.name: endpoint_getComponentReadiness
methods.description: Retrieves the list of components' readiness status.

methods.name: endpoint_setComponentReadiness
methods.description: Sets the readiness status for a specified component.

methods.name: endpoint_reset
methods.description: Resets the migration state based on specified reset type.
